ports.name: New Castle, NH
ports.note: Piscataqua River channel ~200 m off the UNH Judd Gregg Marine Research Complex pier - ENC-verified 9.1-18.2 m (the pierside position first tried sits in a 1.8 m area, inside the DriX's floor). CURRENTS: gomofs is the right model for the Gulf of Maine, but it publishes 3-HOURLY frames and the vendored currents.py assumes hourly (both at fetch and in its frame indexing), so the readout reports the limit rather than a number. Fixing it means changing the vendored module - do it UPSTREAM in the Fuel planner and re-vendor, not here.
